text:
Predicates:
Romance(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropean(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
Within(x, y) ::: x is within y.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French ::: French (constant).
Spanish ::: Spanish (constant).
German ::: German (constant).
Basque ::: Basque (constant).
Premises:
∀x (Romance(x) → IndoEuropean(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
Romance(RomanceLanguages) ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
∀x (LanguageFamily(x) ∧ ∀y (Within(y, x) → Related(y, z))) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
Romance(French) ∧ Romance(Spanish) ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
¬Related(Basque, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
Conclusion:
Basque ::: Basque is a Romance language.
